Research is SUFFICIENT: sources src-kes-1 to src-kes-4 were read. Fit is FIT. Format (long-form multi-day trail video) and geography (Scandinavia) match strongly, and audience values (gear that lasts) match moderately via the lifetime repair pledge. Strongest opportunity: Kestrel's Field Notes program, which funds three long-form Scandinavian trail videos a year by independent creators; applications for the 2027 season open in November 2026 per the brand. A second angle builds a story around the repair pledge and Bergen workshop. Strongest counterargument: Field Notes is application-based with only three slots, and the 2027 window is not open yet; payment terms, selection criteria and Kestrel's budget are unknown (trade press says budgets were not disclosed). Contact: partnerships@kestrel.example.com, a published creator-partnership mailbox, is verified and not catch-all, so readiness is ELIGIBLE_FOR_GATES (policy 1.0.0). That is not send authorization or compliance clearance. The customer-service address was deliberately not selected. Unknowns: budget, whether Field Notes is paid, selection criteria, rights and exclusivity, and whether Kestrel works with creators outside the program. The creator's audience claim is volatile (observed 2026-09-01). The canonical validators were not available in this run, so schema and chain validation were not executed and are not claimed as passed. Next safe action: human review of the artifacts, then the downstream pipeline stages, which belong to ana-outreach-compose and the runtime."}
